URL: https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/cgrkv8e8l9qt
NOTE: BBC News live (Mon 20 Jul eve, developing into Tue). Trump-Burnham first call readout: Trump said on Truth Social he had a "very good conversation" with Burnham; call "went very well" and was "interesting". They discussed North Sea oil, the military alliance, the de-mining of the Strait of Hormuz and "many other topics". Trump: "The Prime Minister has got a big job ahead of him, but he will be able to do it and, of course, the U.S.A. will be there to help!" Suggested the pair will meet in person in the "not too distant future". Downing Street said Burnham told Trump he hopes to show him "what Manchester has to offer" in a future visit (amid speculation next year's G20 could be held in the North West). Context: Trump earlier branded the UK a "Poverty Stricken Disaster" over the North Sea (covered in morning edition). APPROVED SOURCE (bbc.co.uk).
